a: Timeouts leave senders unsure, so redelivery is unavoidable; guarantees stop at at-least-once transport.

q: How do idempotent receivers fake exactly-once?
a: Idempotency keys plus a dedup window: redeliveries answer from the record instead of re-executing.

q: How do you size the dedup window?
a: Past the slowest retry: anything arriving after expiry looks like new work.
